youtubeMusicImport.howToTitle: How do I share my Liked Music?
youtubeMusicImport.howToStep1: On music.youtube.com, open Library → Liked Music.
youtubeMusicImport.howToStep2: Select the songs (click one, then Shift+click to select a range).
youtubeMusicImport.howToStep3: Choose "Add to playlist" → New playlist, and set visibility to Unlisted or Public.
youtubeMusicImport.howToStep4: Open the new playlist, tap Share → Copy link, and paste it above.
youtubeMusicImport.howToAnyPlaylist: Any public or unlisted playlist of songs you love works too, e.g. your party or workout mix.
